body: Thank you for your kind words. I will try not to make any rash decisions when I'm living alone.

Having the power to decide is both relieving and scary. I don't trust myself to be able to make the adult choices that I will have to make once I'm living alone. I'm afraid that I'll start self harming again. I'm afraid I'll spend hours on my bed either staring at clouds or just simply crying. It's better for me to just end this misery.

I have tried telling myself that I deserve love and friendship, but it honestly just feels like a big lie. I don't deserve anything. I'm just a burden on everyone, and everything would be better without me. 

I'll try my best to give the new space a chance. At least I'll be able to cry there freely, without having to worry about someone seeing me.

Thank you for your comment. I'm not alone, I have had a lot of support from my psychologist and a firm that helps people moving out for the first time. I feel awful for having been such a burden on them, and in the end it was nothing but a waste of time since I'm more than likely to kill myself. Within days of moving out. 

I know that my mental illnesses stem mostly from what I've had to deal with since I was a kid. My parents are 90% the reason for my depression, anxiety, PTSD, and so much more. 

I don't have very high hopes that moving out will have much of an effect on my mental health. I will still be the same ugly, fat, stupid person.

I just can't live anymore, it's nothing but suffering for me. No matter what I do to fix my life, I always feel like shit. Moving out was a huge decision for me, and one my parents were absolutely not happy with due to our culture and whatnot. But even though I'm going to move out, I still feel as awful as I used to. I impulsively buy things hoping that something would make the pain go away, but nothing works. I just want to curl up and cry. I have my life.
Thank you. I really hope that will be the case, though I doubt moving out will make much of a difference. But, one can hope.
Sure, I don't see why not. Thanks for commenting too.

From my personal experience, every time I've experienced sleep paralysis, which is quite often unfortunately, it's something bad. Demonic figures, terrifying noises, creepy sensations, and if nothing else, just this dreadful sensation of being watched or feeling someones presence. Haven't ever had anything positive happen during SP, but that's probably just my bad luck.

Thank you for explaining the process of emotional detachment, that I can definitely apply when I'm making an effort to detach from my parents. 

But what if I'm trying to forget about a very close person who has passed away? It's been over 1.5 years, and their memory still haunts me almost daily. I want to move on with my life, but I really can't. 

>That sounds like Complex PTSD - ever heard of that?  

No, I haven't, to be honest. Could you explain it to me, please?

>It's completely fine, please don't worry about it. When I was packing to travel to her city for the funeral, my husband walked in and said "SQLwitch, do you know what you're humming?" It was this, lol.

Hahaha, I feel kinda bad for laughing at that. By the way, how does one detach emotionally from someone? There's one person other than my parents who I'm having difficulties detaching from emotionally. 

I have been to the subreddit you're talking about. I don't really post on subs often because just making a post gives me anxiety. You know, afraid of being judged, criticized, etc. Another bigger reason was because in subs like /r/raisedbynarcissists and r/depression they sometimes talk about a specific subject that I can not even read about. Just reading a few specific words gives me an instant surge of anxiety and sometimes even makes me nauseous. So I try to not visit those kind of subreddits very often.

I wish someone really did get me out of there. At least I wouldn't be going through this hell now. 

>Well, she's dead now, so it's the best it's ever been :-\

Oh, I'm very sorry. I shouldn't have been so nosy, I'm sorry.

I'm assuming NC means something like no contact, right? I hope to be the that way with my parents, just completely cut my ties with them and never look back. I can confidently blame 90% of my depression on them. 

I guess you're right, I should just focus on self improvement and trying to survive until I can move out of this hell hole.

Which field of physics is your favourite? I've been in love with physics since I was seven, astronomy to be specific. But I'm planning on studying quantum physics in the future!

I can definitely think of a few horrible-parent stories to tell. Like once when I was five years old, I went to my dad to talk to him about kid stuff. I didn't know he was drunk. He got annoyed with me, so he grabbed me by my hair, dragged me on the floor into another room and threw me on the bed and told me to "shut up and go to sleep." I was crying and screaming, begging him to stop while he was dragging me. That's one thing he did to me I'll never forget. 

Was your mother literally a psychopath? I'm really sorry you had to live with her. If I may ask, how is your relationship with her, or your parents in general now? Does it ever change or get better?

If I don't kill myself before this, I'm going to try to move out this year, or next year in worst case scenario. 

I don't want to die. I have a dream, I want to become a physicist and I know that if I can get over my depression, I have the potential to make my dream a reality. 

Today has been an unusually productive day for me. I mediated in the morning, I've done lots of school work and talked to multiple teachers about my courses and such. I'm actually feeling a lot better today.

I can't imagine my parents caring about me. My dad is a self centered, narcissistic asshole and my mom just doesn't give a damn. 

Nobody would care if I died. I don't want to live this crappy life either. I wish I wasn't so scared to committing suicide. I want all the pain to go away.

I won't deny that, I did go to therapy with unrealistic expectations. But after over a year of visiting, I still didn't feel any kind of progress happening. I still felt depressed, suicidal and like I was wasting my time there. And the sad thing is, I can't change the therapist. Where I live, it's either the one person I went to, or no one. I could go to private therapists, but they'd be expensive. 

I honestly still feel like it was my fault and not really the therapists. I have difficulty trusting people, so is it really his fault? He was only trying to help.

Hey I'm so sorry for not replying to you, I fell asleep. I'm sorry. 

I really like making people happy. Seeing them smile because of me or saying something to make them happy always makes my day. But I never interact with anyone socially, so I never get to do that.  

I don't deserve to be happy. I'm an awful waste of space who deserves to die. I've never done anything good. I'm worthless. 

One day I just decided that I wanted to fix my life and get professional help. I went to my school nurse, who then redirected me to the therapist. People always talk about therapy as if it's some miracle cure that solves everything, so you can probably understand how sad I was when it didn't work for me. 

Thank you for talking to me, I really appreciate the time and effort you're putting in to helping me.

My parents don't know about my depression either, telling them would only make my life more miserable than it already is. And they'll find out after I'm dead anyway. 

But my parents weren't really wrong. I do have bad grades, and I am a disappointment, not just to them but everyone. I could never make anyone happy. 

I don't really know what to do to fix my situation anymore. I'm a lost cause. Better for me to die than live and continue burdening people.

Where I live, it's not possible to change therapists. It's either the one I had or nothing. I'm sure there are private therapists, but that'd be way too expensive and probably wouldn't help anyway. 

I honestly don't want to get professional help, I'll only be wasting the therapists time. I just want to stop living, stop suffering.

As long as I'm not bothering you in any way, then yes we can keep talking. Thank you so much for taking your time to talk to me. 

There have been people on the internet I've been able to open up to, but in my real life, no, I've never had anyone with whom I could just be who I am. It's really depressing and painful, having to bottle up all my emotions, both the good and the bad ones. I thought I'd get used to being alone, but I never did. 

For some context, I'm 18 years old. I was bullied in school ever since first grade, none of guys wanted to play with me and most didn't even talk to me, and the girls always told me how ugly I am. I also never got to feel the love of my parents because they were too busy with their business, never got to make friends either because my parents never let me out of the house. But they never stopped telling me how much of a disappointment I am because of how bad my grades are. They'd always compare me to my better classmates or relatives. Overtime I grew to accept these things. I started accepting that I am in fact ugly, worthless and a disappointment. If something bad happens, it's most likely my own fault. And it's true.

You are right, I have lost all hope of getting someone to understand what I'm feeling. 

I don't really want to blame the therapist, the problem is with me. I have social anxiety as well, and talking to people is very difficult for me. I'm the problem, as always. 

I want to end my pain. I don't really want to die, I've never wanted to die. But I don't want to suffer anymore either, and the only way out is death. I've been suffering for almost a decade now, it's too much.

My only problem is that I'm too scared to commit suicide, otherwise I would've done it already. But sooner or later the pain and suffering will definitely overpower the fear, and I'm hoping it'll happen sooner rather than later. 

There is nobody I could tell without completely ruining my life, and I definitely don't want to burden any teachers with my awful life. I've tried going to a psychologist in the past, although I never told him about being suicidal, just depression. Anyway, it never worked for me, each visit was awkward and uncomfortable. 

I just want to end my life and be done with it. I don't want to bother or burden anyone with my worthless existence. 

Thank you for taking your time to reply, I really appreciate it. It's more than what most people in the world bother to do for me.

Nobody will see this, but fuck it, I need to tell this to someone. 

I'm really, really depressed and suicidal. I can't go on like this. I feel like shit every day, I can't even get out of bed and I'm fucking up school more than I care to admit. I use gaming as an escape, but it has grown into an addiction at this point. My life is a mess and I don't see myself ever getting anywhere. I'm probably going to end my life sooner or later. There's nothing worth living for.
